items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: I had did the things for Wynonie Harris... I did a lot of things personally for Glover like 'All She Wanna Do Is Rock with Wynonie Harris'... I did 'All She Wanna Do I Rock,' which was a smash hit for Wynonie Harris.

ctx.x: No, this was either a trumpet player or saxophone player. These are the different men in the band.
But the most important thing was Glover and Bill Doggett came out of that particular band. We stayed there a whole year.
